IntSimMissText: Attribution did not recover after the PMU returned: 0 of the 7 later interventions in these records were attributed in time, against 4 of 4 before the dropout. On the completed normal record the two held intervals produced 2 alarms (the second normal record of this scenario was not run). A held value is a measurement that contradicts the network response, not an absent one; the bank therefore needs the deletion of Proposition~\ref{prop:integrity}, an availability-switched observation operator, rather than imputation.
